analysis.summary: Management discussed Fonebox Retail Limited's financial performance for H1 FY 2024-25, highlighting a 17% revenue increase and an 11% growth in PAT compared to H1 FY 2024. The company outlined its store expansion plans focusing primarily on Maharashtra alongside Gujarat, operating under a mix of COCO and FOCO models. Management provided guidance for the current financial year and FY 2026, while also addressing questions regarding inventory management systems, financing costs, and industry demand trends. Fonebox Retail Limited reported its investor presentation for the half year ended September 30, 2024, highlighting operational active stores and financial performance including revenue from operations at Rs. 16465.28 lakhs.

guidance.claim: Management projected a revenue target of over 400 crore without tax, translating to approximately 464 to 470 crore with tax for FY 25.
guidance.quote: Revenue target for this year FY. 25. Our revenue target is 400 plus at least. If we calculate with tax it will nearly around so it is without tax. We are seeing on the balance sheet part on the Tax. With the tax it will lead around 464-470 crore.

demand_outlook.claim: Physical retail has been increasing over the last 6 quarters compared to online retail.
demand_outlook.quote: Also, a physical retail is being increasing since last 2 years. If we see quarter on quarter data online versus physical retail as near to equivalent before 6 quarters. But since last 6 quarter, if we see the data physical retail is being increasing every day.

demand_outlook.claim: Online sales have kept decreasing over the last 6 quarters due to profit pressures on e-commerce companies.
demand_outlook.quote: As I told earlier, that since last 6 quarter this, online sales is kept on decreasing, there is a reason behind it. So the 1st reason is this, both of e-commerce company is in now under a profit, pressures. Even if it is an Amazon or Flipkart, both are under a profit pressure. Right now.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that future store openings will maintain a split of 3 company-owned to 7 franchisee-owned stores.
capex_expansion.quote: 3 will be company owned, and 7 will be Franchisee. Own company operated.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's geographic expansion focus for 2025 will be primarily on Maharashtra.
capex_expansion.quote: So 2025, you are more focus will be on Maharashtra only.

capex_expansion.claim: The company entered into a definitive Share Subscription and Purchase Agreement dated May 22, 2026, for acquiring 100% equity shareholding in NWOM Retailers Private Limited for a total consideration of ₹25.74 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Subsequent to the financial year ended March 31, 2026, and prior to the approval of the Board’s Report for FY 2025-26 by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on August 19, 2026, the Company entered into a definitive Share Subscription and Purchase Agreement (“SSPA”) dated May 22, 2026, for the acquisition of 100% equity shareholding in NWOM Retailers Private Limited.

margins_costs.claim: The company successfully negotiated to increase its margins with three brands: Samsung, Vivo, and Xiaomi.
margins_costs.quote: I'm seeing on the some of the brands like Samsung, Vivo and Xiaomi. We are successful this year to increment our margin, and for rest of the brands, we are working closely to increase our margin.

management_commitments.claim: The company's primary focus for 2025 will be sales, per square feet per store revenue, and per person revenue.
management_commitments.quote: So now this year 2025, we have only one thing to focus, which is a per square feet per store revenue, and we are also introducing a per person revenue this year.

management_commitments.claim: The company's focus for 2025 will be primarily on Maharashtra.
management_commitments.quote: So 2025, you are more focus will be on Maharashtra only.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
